title: PRIDE's PTM field flags 81% of deposited phospho site tables but only 60% of GlyGly ones
sub:
PRIDE datasets 2013–2025 whose deposited MaxQuant output shows site tables (n = 6,114; the default Oxidation (M)Sites table makes them visible).
A site table means the modification was searched as variable, not that it was enriched. a, modifications with a site table. b, of datasets with
that site table, share whose metadata names the modification. c, share with a phospho site table, by which metadata sources mention phospho.
Whiskers: 95% CI, group bootstrap over contributor groups. Absence means "not detected". MaxQuant only.
